programme.desc: He was a gifted footballer, calm as a trainer and always inimitable: Willem van Hanegem. Embraced by football-loving Netherlands, praised in Rotterdam, the city of 'his' Feyenoord. programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): El Chou» The 90s promise strong emotions in a Spain that is preparing to host the Olympic Games and a Universal Exhibition. The Minister of Economy declares that this is the country where it is easiest to get rich. In this context, the government decides to put a stop to the excesses in football, where clubs owe fortunes to the Treasury. But by converting them into Sports Joint Stock Companies, the shot backfires: a new line of presidents comes to power. They are successful businessmen seeking fame and opportunities for their private businesses. In Seville, Manuel Ruiz de Lopera saves Betis from disappearance at the last minute and becomes an idol for the fans. He moves the club's offices to his immense mansion and leads him to carry out unimaginable deeds. The popularity of presidents soars

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: The Pantanal (S1E10). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep10
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep10 «Brazil Untamed»…The Pantanal is one of the world's great reservoirs for plant and animal life. Scientists estimate that it's home to 80 species of mammals, 650 species of birds, 50 species of reptiles, and over 300 species of fish. It's the largest tropical wetland on Earth, yet it's also one of the most unforgiving habitats to call homeThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Toads)
programme.desc: Through sweet fiction, we reveal the adventurous spirit of our rivers' protagonists. These are trout and salmon. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Trout and Salmon)
programme.desc: In this episode, we delve into the world of trout and salmon, amazing reservoir fish found in both fresh and salt water. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/f Bees. Invisible mechanism
programme.desc: Our planet is facing the threat of an environmental crisis: the population of insects, including bees, is rapidly declining. The reasons for this are climate change, loss of natural habitat and overuse of pesticides. In this documentary, we explore how bees and other insects play a key role in maintaining ecosystems by pollinating plants and ensuring the yield of the fruits and vegetables we eat. Spain

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wildlife (Predators of Africa)
programme.desc: More or less direct descendants of dinosaurs, birds are divided into about 20 families that experts consider nonetheless fairly homogeneous. Africa is the best place to observe the often strange and impressive behavior of birds. France

programme.title: d/f Journey of the Wolf
programme.desc: The incredible story of a wolf named Slava, which shocked the scientific community. His own pack rejected him and forced him to travel thousands of kilometers from the depths of the Romanian tundra to the shores of the Atlantic Ocean. During this difficult journey he will meet a female, and together they form a new pack. France

programme.title: d/s Clean Water Gardens (Asia)
programme.desc: Water is a force of nature that shapes the behavior of animals and opens up new facets of survival and harmony on all continents of the Earth. In Antarctica, this element is concentrated in glaciers, in Latin America it fills rivers and jungles, in Africa it ensures the existence of savannas, and in Asia it becomes a decisive factor in conditions of natural contrasts. Spain

programme.title: d/s Galapagos: At the End of the Earth (Survival)
programme.desc: It is home to many species of plants and animals that are found nowhere else on the planet. Unfortunately, due to human activity and climate change, some species have become endangered. Dir.: Chan Won-joon. South Korea

programme.title: d/f Natural mystery of the East
programme.desc: France

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Kingdom of the Sun)
programme.desc: Madagascar deciduous forests grow in the center and northwest of the island. In a rocky area scorched by the rays of the sun, only those animals and plants that have adapted to heat and drought over many millennia can survive. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Ghosts of the Jungle)
programme.desc: Madagascar has become the only refuge for many unique species of animals and plants. However, some of the island's inhabitants are on the verge of extinction. How do they survive and adapt to a changing environment? Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 5 s.
programme.desc: The project immerses the viewer in the cruel but amazing world of wild nature, where every day is a struggle for life. Kill or be killed - these are the only rules of the game that animals obey. But how do they cope with these harsh conditions? How has evolution taught them to adapt and survive in a world full of dangers? Canada

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 6 p.

programme.title: d/s Force of nature (Terrestrial animals)
programme.desc: Between sea and land lies a special world: at low tide it is land, at high tide it is water. Sometimes immersed in the abyss, sometimes dried up by the wind and sun. Here evolution does not stop for a moment, and only the most persistent creatures adapt. China

programme.title: d/s On the brink of extinction (Central America)
programme.desc: Join us to learn more about the fight to preserve Central America's unique wildlife and what can be done to prevent extinction. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/f Belovezhskaya Pushcha
programme.desc: The first time you enter Belovezhskaya Pushcha as an ordinary park, the Master, the rightful owner. You breathe greedily in the resinous air until your head hurts, you break the rough tree bark, tear leaves, or even grind some small insect into dust. Just like that, out of half-childish inquisitiveness. It seems to you that all this is yours, it seems normal that man is always insatiable, and nature is always generous. But as soon as you step away from the beaten path, the first delights are replaced by slight fear: are you the master of all this thousand-year-old thicket? And you are already afraid of your loneliness, your insignificance, your weakness in front of the centuries-old pines, because a person has only the knowledge that civilization has given him, and the Pushcha has the memory of all the deeds of man. Director: Liliya Samoilova. Belarus

programme.title: d/f Pripyat National Park
programme.desc: Pripyatsky National Park is a natural area in the south of Belarus with unique biodiversity and international status as a key ornithological area. The natural biocomplexes of Europe have been preserved here; 256 species of birds live here, 65 of which are listed in the country’s Red Book. The park is famous for Europe's largest floodplain for migratory birds and is one of the popular tourist destinations in Belarus. Belarus

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: TRẠI THÀNH CỬU LONG - KOWLOON WALLED CITY
programme.desc: Neng là một chiến binh đường phố ở Đông Bắc Trung Quốc nhưng quyết định bắt đầu cuộc sống mới ở Thành phố có tường bao quanh Cửu Long của Hồng Kông. Thật không may, anh ta lại dính líu đến những cuộc chiến và âm mưu giữa các thế lực bộ ba. Khi người bạn tốt của mình bị bộ ba truy lùng, Neng phải hợp tác với cư dân của Thành phố có tường bao quanh Cửu Long để chống trả và cứu bạn mình.

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?
